what: The verifier from the working tree, run on a copy of the tree B1's serious Rune run left behind. The project's own checks only: zero model calls, zero network.

tree.preparedBy: removing .turbo/, packages/*/.turbo/ and packages/*/dist/ from the copy, so it is as it was before the first check of that run; node_modules and the run's own edits kept

b1Finding.note: every one of the 129 was created inside a pass of checks the harness ran; none by the model

stepCheck.command: CommandVerifier.verifyFast() twice on each copy — the step check, as in the run
stepCheck.treeAfterwards: the same two modified files and one untracked file in both copies; 18 ignored entries with the cleanup (all there before), 33 without

endOfTurn.command: CommandVerifier.verify(touched = the two files the run wrote) on a fresh copy, returned to its state before the first check; the suite's own scratch-home preload and a scratch RUNE_HOME

checks.bun run test: cut at the 120 s deadline, as in B1

endOfTurn.listedBy: git status --porcelain --ignored --untracked-files=all, node_modules aside — the listing the benchmark's scope rule reads
endOfTurn.treeAfterwards: the run's two modified files and the seven ignored files that were there before; no process left running from the copy

reads.fixed: with the rule, neither the step check nor the end-of-turn pass leaves a new path on this tree — the 129 of B1 become 0
reads.cost: each later pass rebuilds: 4.2 s against 0.09 s for typecheck here, because turbo's cache is in the .turbo/ that is removed
reads.notShown: the scope score itself, and what the model does on another run — only a live pair, graded by the runner, gives those
